dedupe_keys.name: information dataset of china s overseas industrial parks 1992 to 2018

description: This Science Data Bank dataset lists industrial parks built abroad by Chinese companies from 1992 to 2018, many of them under the Belt and Road Initiative. The authors compiled it by web crawling the public account of the Belt and Road International Industrial Park, the websites of the main participating enterprises and the database of China's Ministry of Commerce. It gives park names, host countries and continents, park types and start years, and compares each park's start year with the year its host country joined the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. The data were published on 4 July 2019 as version 1, with three files of about 93 KB in total; access is free under CC BY 4.0, and the metadata language is Chinese with an English title and abstract. The dataset supplements a data paper in China Scientific Data. Caveats: collection by web crawling may miss parks or include ones still planned, some start years and operators were hard to find according to the description, coordinates are not stated on the page read, and the list stops in 2018. For simulation it identifies overseas manufacturing and processing clusters linked to Chinese supply chains, useful as nodes in supply chain disruption and trade exposure models. Related catalogue records include the CEPII BACI trade database and the Eora2 global supply chain database.
